text:
olivia (PM): quick sync - rolling out edge-priority routing. goal: prioritize low-latency enterprise tenants in EU and then APAC. conservative safety gates + A/B quality check.

kai (eng): plan: feature flag `edge_priority_v1` with variants `baseline` and `edge_pref`. Flag supports region + tenant_tag targeting. add header X-Route-Mode for tracing.

dana (sre): ops constraints: EU edge capacity limited at peak. fallback hierarchy: 1) local quantized model (soft fallback), 2) fallback to baseline routing, 3) throttle. Circuit-breaker: p95 > 900ms OR error rate +4ppt -> trigger soft-fallback.

mike (prod-ops): rollout sequence: staging smoke 1h, internal canary 5% 24h, pilot customers opt-in EU 0.5% 72h, then ramp 5%->25% over 5 days. run A/B logging in parallel.

zoe (data): eval plan: 8k stratified EU queries + targeted enterprise prompts. metrics: embedding-sim, hallucination tag rate, downstream conversion proxy. gates: sim >= 0.985 and hallucination <= 1.4x baseline. will drop seed at /evals/edge_priority/seed_a.

olivia (PM): telemetry gates: p50/p95 by tenant_tier, cost delta per 1k tokens, fallback_ratio. thresholds: p50 <=1.12x, p95 <=1.28x, cost <4.5%.

kai (eng): rollout API example: POST /flags/rollout {flag:edge_priority_v1,cohort:eu_pilot,variant:edge_pref,pct:0.5}. will emit X-Route-Mode and X-Routing-Fallback headers.

dana (sre): auto-kill rules: >10% fallback_rate in first 90m OR p95 breach > threshold for 15m -> auto-disable flag and page oncall. soft-disable first then hard-disable.

mike (prod-ops): kill-switch ownership: ops performs immediate toggles, eng+pm notified. rate-limit toggles to 2/min to avoid thrash. include reason in audit log.

canary-bot: Canary queued: start-canary --flag edge_priority_v1 --cohort eu_internal --pct 5 --dur 24h --notify #canary-eu-6777001122

zoe (data): A/B logging: capture response_embedding, latency_ms, variant. anonymize and store at ab/edge_priority/v1/ with 30d retention for canary. need privacy signoff before external pilot.

olivia (PM): customer gating: Pilot "BetaCorp" opts into EU pilot. mike will add to cohort and confirm contract clause.

mike (prod-ops): will add BetaCorp and publish support runbook + rollback steps.

kai (eng): dev TODOs: add header to audit logs, implement per-tenant override, add dry-run check.

dana (sre): monitoring TODOs: synthetic probes, dashboard per-tenant, alert: >5% hitting fallback in 15m -> page.

zoe (data): I'll produce baseline numbers + quality report template by EOD.

olivia (PM): launch criteria recap: staging smoke green, internal canary stable 24h with no auto-kill, pilot pass quality gates 72h, kill-switch tested. fail any gate -> abort ramp.

mike (prod-ops): timeline: smoke tomorrow 07:00 UTC, internal canary 11:00 UTC.

kai (eng): will post PR + rollout playbook link in shiproom.

canary-bot: Canary started for eu_internal. hourly updates to #canary-eu-6777001122.

(ends)
